title: Shopping Cart Management Flow

steps: Validate session: check username, password, usertype='customer'
Get prodId from param 'pid', pQty from param 'pqty'
[pQty == cartQty] (requested qty=0) → CartServiceImpl.removeProductFromCart(userId, prodId) → forward userHome.jsp → END
forward cartDetails.jsp with status message → END
[else] (stock sufficient) → CartServiceImpl.updateProductToCart(userId, prodId, pQty) → forward userHome.jsp → END
Get prodId from param 'pid', pQty from param 'pqty'
forward cartDetails.jsp with stock-limit message → END
[else] (stock sufficient) → CartServiceImpl.updateProductToCart(userId, prodId, pQty) → forward cartDetails.jsp → END

activity_flows.flow: Remove Product from Catalog (RemoveProductSrv.doGet — Admin only)
steps: ProductServiceImpl.removeProduct(prodId) → status (removes from product catalog table)
SELECT from usercart WHERE username=userId AND prodid=prodId
[row exists AND qty > 0] → UPDATE usercart SET quantity=qty
[row exists AND qty == 0] → DELETE from usercart (remove item entirely)
[row not found] → INSERT INTO usercart (userId, prodId, qty) (new cart entry)
SELECT from usercart WHERE username=userId AND prodid=prodId
[not found] → status='Product Not Available in the cart!'

key_conditions: Session check: username + password + usertype required (AddtoCart requires usertype='customer')
RemoveProductSrv requires usertype='admin' — catalog removal, not cart removal
Stock check in AddtoCart: pQty (requested+existing) vs availableQty from product table
pQty == cartQty means user requested qty=0 → triggers cart item removal
Demand recording: when requested qty exceeds stock, deficit quantity stored in demand table + email promised
updateProductToCart handles both INSERT (new) and UPDATE (existing) cart rows
key_relationships: AddtoCart depends_on DemandServiceImpl (addProduct) — for out-of-stock demand tracking
CartServiceImpl reads/writes Database (usercart table via DBUtil/JDBC)
ProductServiceImpl reads/writes Database (product table via DBUtil/JDBC)
view_transitions: UpdateToCart → cartDetails.jsp (both success and stock-capped paths)
important_notes: AddtoCart and UpdateToCart are customer-facing servlets sharing the same stock-check + demand pattern. RemoveProductSrv is admin-only and removes products from the catalog (product table), not from a user cart. Cart removal from user cart uses CartServiceImpl.removeProductFromCart (decrement-by-1 logic) or removeAProduct (hard delete). updateProductToCart acts as upsert: INSERT if not in cart, UPDATE if exists, DELETE if qty=0.
